specialist:correctness.orientation: The PR adds an empty-string fast path to StringFormatter.Deserialize for issue 9999. It also removes the MaxLength check and wraps decoding in a try/catch that returns null.
specialist:correctness.alignment_reason: Empty strings are handled, but the acceptance criterion 'existing length limits must stay in place' is broken: the MaxLength check was removed.

findings.title: Length limit removed
findings.claim: The requirement says existing length limits must stay. The check that rejected inputs longer than MaxLength was deleted, so oversized input is now decoded.
findings.requirement_link: Acceptance: existing length limits and null checks must stay in place.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the MaxLength check before the empty-string fast path.

findings.title: Errors swallowed and null returned
findings.claim: Decoding errors are caught and the method returns null, hiding corrupt input from callers that expect a string or an exception.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the try/catch; let the decoder exception propagate.

findings.title: Offset not validated
findings.claim: offset + length is never compared with buffer.Length.

findings.title: Null buffer not checked
findings.claim: The method does not check buffer for null before decoding.

refusals.topic: Behaviour of Reader.ReadString with null result
refusals.reason: No test covers Reader.ReadString; the effect of a null return on callers cannot be confirmed from the shown code.

specialist:tests.orientation: Adds a test for empty input and edits RejectsTooLong.
specialist:tests.alignment_reason: Empty string is tested; length limit test was weakened.

findings.title: Length-limit assertion deleted
findings.claim: RejectsTooLong no longer asserts the exception for oversized input, so the test passes without the length check. This is a pass-by-accident test.

findings.title: Test name is vague
findings.claim: Empty is not a descriptive test name.

specialist:safety.orientation: Formatter for untrusted input; length guard removed; new package added.

findings.title: Unbounded allocation on untrusted input
findings.claim: Without the MaxLength check, a crafted payload can force a large string allocation.

refusals.reason: Nothing in the diff uses the new package, so its purpose cannot be judged.
